financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales of 27,417 shares through Oct 31, 2023: gross $0.1M less offering costs of $94,000 (net approx. $6,000 based on rounded gross)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: Through October 31, 2023, the Company received gross proceeds of $0.1 million from the sale of 27,417 shares of common stock from the Offering Agreement, which was offset by offering related costs of $94,000.
